description: The raw accelerometer, and nothing else: an Accelerometer interface with an isAvailable gate and a cold observe(): Flow<AccelerometerSample> that registers the platform sensor on collection and releases it when collection ends. Pick this module if your shared Kotlin code wants raw acceleration in m/s² on both platforms without writing the SensorManager dance on Android and the CMMotionManager g-to-m/s² conversion on iOS — it interprets nothing, declares no permission or feature of its own, and reports missing hardware as a typed isAvailable flag instead of throwing.
